request: What are the costs of federal student loan forgiveness programs such as Public Service Loan Forgiveness?

reply.reply:
CRS reports **$37.4 billion in PSLF loan balances forgiven in FY2023**—but that is not the same as the federal government’s budget cost. CRS says government cost information for forgiveness programs is limited; its budget “subsidy cost” measure uses the discounted present value of government cash flows, and PSLF’s cost is not separately estimated in the reviewed evidence. (CRS R47837, PDF p. 6; CRS R43571, PDF p. 32)

The reviewed reports do not provide a standalone budget-cost estimate for PSLF. See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-175113-e61b.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: Verified CRS evidence reports FY2023 nominal balances forgiven and explains why that figure is not equivalent to federal budget subsidy cost. The reviewed sources do not give a separate PSLF cost estimate.
